messages.author: 6e3bf202055f2791
messages.subject: lavaan not available in Ubuntu
parts:
Dear all,
I get this message when I try to install lavaan on the latest Ubuntu LTS 14 version:

package ‘lavaan’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)

Can anyone help?

Thank you

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: lavaan not available in Ubuntu
parts: package ‘lavaan’ is not available (for R version 3.0.2)

We are now in R version 3.2.3, so you should try to update R.  Your current version is from 2013.

https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/old/

I think the last version of lavaan built for R 3.0 was 0.5-16.  You can always find old versions by clicking on the link to "Old sources" when you look up the package description on CRAN.

https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/lavaan/

If you can't build (or find a built copy of) R 3.2 for Ubuntu, then you can download the source code for lavaan 0.5-16 from the archive linked above, then install it directly from the source.

install.packages("PATH TO YOUR lavaan FILE", type = "source", repos = NULL)

You could also install it by using the appropriate URL linking to the source code you want:

install.packages("https://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/lavaan/lavaan_0.5-16.tar.gz",
                 type = "source", repos = NULL)

Feel free to try lavaan 0.5-19 first, then work your way back in time if that doesn't work.  I'm not sure when your incompatibility actually began.  But the ideal situation is updating R, because many updates to lavaan have been made since 2013.

Terry
